name: Engineers in Action
tagline: We're a team of about 25 UW students who design a suspended footbridge for a rural community in Bolivia every year, and then send members to build it with the community.
footerLine: One year, one bridge, every year.
purpose: Rivers in rural Bolivia can be impossible to cross for almost half the year, which cuts families off from school, farmland, markets, and healthcare during the rainy season. The Washington Chapter of Engineers in Action designs a suspended footbridge for one of these communities each year, working with Engineers in Action's professional engineers and teams from other universities. Each summer, a few of our members travel to Bolivia and build the bridge alongside community members and local masons.

sponsorUses.title: Materials and services
sponsorUses.text: Engineers in Action requires a contribution of $3,125 for each traveler toward the bridge's materials and skilled masons. With two travelers, that comes to $6,250.

sponsorUses.title: Airfare
sponsorUses.text: Flights to Bolivia for two travelers cost about $3,600.

sponsorUses.title: Food and in-country travel
sponsorUses.text: At about $9.89 per person per day, six weeks on site comes to roughly $1,000.

meetingInfo: General meetings are on Wednesdays at 5:30 PM in CMU 230.

bridgeCost.note: Figures are from the 2026 Pilipilicito bridge, converted at 6.86 bolivianos to the dollar.

sponsorUsesNote: Anything we raise beyond this goal rolls over to next year's bridge.
